detail.title: MG15 Super Cube Wireless Controller - Black/Yellow
detail.overview: The Ant Esports MG15 Super Cube is a modular wireless controller that splits into two halves, attaching to either side of a smartphone to transform it into a compact handheld gaming console. The left half features a joystick, D-pad, home button and analog triggers, giving comprehensive control beyond touch input for battle royale, shooting, racing and action games. A lightweight, ergonomic design paired with a phone holder clamp fits screens from 4.7 to 6.8 inches, and it connects via Bluetooth 5.0 with a 10-metre range on Android 6.0+ and iOS 13.0+ devices. Two rechargeable 250mAh batteries provide up to 10 hours of play and recharge fully in about 2 hours via the included USB-C cable, while a carrying case with a spare cable pocket makes it easy to take along wherever you game.
